dataset.citation: Fraser and Massom (2020), Circum-Antarctic landfast sea ice 2000-2018 v2.2, doi:10.26179/5d267d1ceb60c

fixed_geo_reference.name: Ledda Bay historic published centroid, NOT nest polygon
fixed_geo_reference.projected_grid: polar stereographic with true scale 70 degrees south (NSIDC PS70)

validation_first: Download the v2.2 annual original NetCDF by its documented path; log SHA256 and file size
Check x/y monotonic 1D projected coordinates, 1km-scale spacing, time metadata and temporal coverage
Only accept documented physical category codes 0..6 and separately tally 4 interior, 5 manual edge, 6 auto edge
Record all 2011-2012 maps within all fixed local radii and the maps bracketing September 23, 2011
Never move centroid or optimize radius based on prior penguin annotations or favorable map results
predeclared_limits: The physical product is independent of the LaRue satellite-image annotator, not necessarily independent of imagery or systematic satellite confounders
Map timestamp may represent a 15-day composite whose boundaries cross image date; do not claim strict prior exposure until bounds are checked
A 1km pixel near the published rounded colony centroid is not a verified nest footprint
Pixels coded 0 combine sea/ocean/pack and can also be a fill code; do not treat 0 as proven open-water habitat
Seasonal ice at one coastal site is NOT proven accessible, reliable across incubation or fledging, or vacant for a season
Do not infer social inhibition, density dependence, Allee effects, breeding success, immigrant sources, rescue, or a general ecological law
If source downloads/schema validation fail, report HOLD rather than replacing data product
publication_claim_permitted: Independent ice-context audit of a published single-site negative image; not evidence of new penguin ecological causation
